data_description.call_log_limit_type_eingehend: Whether the fritzbox_anrufe_eingehend sensor (Answered calls) is limited by count or by time period.
data_description.call_log_limit_type_ausgehend: Whether the outgoing-calls sensor is limited by count or by time period.
data_description.call_log_limit_type_verpasst: Whether the missed-calls sensor is limited by count or by time period.
data_description.auto_mark_read: When enabled, playing an answering-machine message through this integration (dashboard card or service) also clears its 'new' flag directly on the FRITZ!Box itself - matching real FRITZ!Box hardware/apps. Off by default, since this changes state shared by every device/app (e.g. also the unread count in FRITZ!App Fon), not just this dashboard. Experimental, see README.
data_description.spam_numbers: A call or answering-machine message is flagged as spam if its number matches one of these entries as a prefix, OR if the FRITZ!Box itself already blocked the call. The FRITZ!Box has no native, automatic spam detection - this list is maintained by you. Leave empty to rely only on the FRITZ!Box's own block list.
data_description.spam_name_prefixes: Additionally flags a call or answering-machine message as spam if its (phonebook) name begins with one of these markers - for external blockers such as the PhoneBlock USB stick, which block numbers themselves and prepend e.g. "SPAM:" to the name without the FRITZ!Box rejecting the call or the number being in your spam list. Comma-separated, case-insensitive, matched at the start of the name. Leave empty to disable. Tip: to actually hide these entries, also enable "Hide spam" on the dashboard card.

manage_tams.title: Manage answering machines
manage_tams.description: Currently configured: {count} of up to 5 answering machines. The first answering machine is confirmed on real hardware; every additional one (answering machine 2 and above) is experimental - see README.

delete_voicemail_message.name: Delete answering-machine message
delete_voicemail_message.description: Permanently deletes one answering-machine message from the FRITZ!Box. There is no undo - the FRITZ!Box itself has no trash/recycle bin for these messages.
